description: Source code for the Translation model class in OpenCart admin module, responsible for CRUD operations on translation data stored in the database.

classes.name: Translation
classes.description: Model class for handling translation records within the OpenCart system, providing methods for CRUD operations and querying translations.

methods.name: addTranslation
methods.description: Inserts a new translation record into the database with provided data.

methods.name: editTranslation
methods.description: Updates an existing translation record identified by translation_id with provided data.

methods.name: editStatus
methods.description: Updates the status (enabled/disabled) of a translation record identified by translation_id.

methods.name: deleteTranslation
methods.description: Deletes the translation record with the specified translation_id.

methods.name: deleteTranslationsByStoreId
methods.description: Deletes all translation records associated with a specific store.

methods.name: deleteTranslationsByLanguageId
methods.description: Deletes all translation records associated with a specific language.

methods.name: getTranslation
methods.description: Retrieves a translation record by its translation_id.

methods.name: getTranslations
methods.description: Retrieves a list of translation records based on optional filtering and pagination options.

methods.name: getTotalTranslations
methods.description: Returns the total count of translation records, optionally filtered by store, language, or route.
